feedback_history.therapist_response:
Yes, it makes perfect sense. Your body is reacting to the deep fear that you’re not in control—especially when it comes to your own safety and the safety of the people you care about. The nausea, the shaking, the tightness in your chest… those aren’t just symptoms of anxiety. They’re your body’s way of saying, *“This is too much to carry alone.”*
